summary: The cited Coordination source defines a separate Linux x64 C fixture under fsgg.utel.auth-bootstrap.inert/1 with only describe and inert-fixture modes. Its original-operation label is reference-only; production, credential ingress, same-token cleanup, native constructor and authorization capabilities are false. The fixture requires an exact nonsecret framed sentinel and EOF on FD3 pipe, refuses extra descriptors and malformed input, and uses an absolute monotonic deadline for pipe input/output. A fresh-runner-temp builder records a six-file source/test/workflow/pin-inventory closure, compiler and static ELF observations, binary hash and source head/run/attempt; the read-only hosted workflow tests only fake behavior. This profile is distinct from the managed S4-A linux-x64-finite-inert-fd/1 plan and is not integrated into a project, package, installed host or real credential route. Source and fake-only qualification do not establish selected host composition, key custody, signer, original operation, ACK, same-token cleanup, release or effect authority. Adding the workflow also required an exact Q3 pin-inventory extension, included in the artifact input closure.
title: Inactive UTEL C fixture is separate from managed S4-A and credential admission
